mapper.select: SELECT CATEGORY_ID, CATEGORY_NAME, DESCRIPTION, USE_YN, CREATED_AT FROM CATEGORIES WHERE USE_YN = 'Y' ORDER BY CATEGORY_ID
SELECT LOCATION_ID, LOCATION_NAME, BUILDING_NAME, FLOOR, DETAIL, LATITUDE, LONGITUDE, USE_YN, CREATED_AT FROM LOCATIONS WHERE USE_YN = 'Y' ORDER BY BUILDING_NAME, FLOOR, LOCATION_NAME

SELECT S.STORAGE_ID, S.STORAGE_NAME, S.LOCATION_ID, L.LOCATION_NAME, S.MANAGER_NAME, S.PHONE, S.OPERATING_HOURS, S.DESCRIPTION, S.USE_YN, S.CREATED_AT FROM STORAGE_PLACES S LEFT JOIN LOCATIONS L ON L.LOCATION_ID = S.LOCATION_ID WHERE S.USE_YN = 'Y' ORDER BY S.STORAGE_NAME

SELECT (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM USERS WHERE STATUS = 'ACTIVE') AS USER_COUNT, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM LOST_ITEMS) AS LOST_COUNT, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM FOUND_ITEMS) AS FOUND_COUNT, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM REPORTS) AS REPORT_COUNT, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM REPORTS WHERE STATUS = 'WAITING') AS WAITING_REPORT_COUNT FROM DUAL
